notes.1: Opening question (...ཅེ་ན།) kept as its own paragraph; its answer runs through the whole treatise.
notes.2: Five categories plus the sentence giving the reason for their order: one point.
notes.6: Catechetical 'X gang zhe na' question joined with its list answer: a definitional question, not an objection, so rule 3 not applied. Same for 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 22.
notes.22: S23 fuses the last list item with the treatise's conclusion (...ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་ཕྱིར་བདག་གི་ཆོས་དེ་མེད་པར་གསུངས་སོ།); cannot be split at unit level.
notes.25: End-title (ཡོངས་སུ་རྫོགས་སོ།) is colophon material but numbered S, not [frame]; kept as its own paragraph.
notes.26: Authorship note (Vasubandhu vs. Dharmapāla) is a separate editorial remark; arguably frame material.
